items.stem: Why plan a multi-file feature with Claude Code before editing any code?

options.text: A plan exposes the files and interfaces involved and the order of safe steps before mistakes are made
options.rationale: Correct: planning surfaces dependencies and ordering so changes stay coherent.

options.text: Planning removes the need to run the tests
options.rationale: Tests are still required; planning does not replace verification.

options.text: Planning guarantees the feature is bug-free
options.rationale: No planning step guarantees bug-free code.

options.text: Planning lets Claude Code skip reviewing the diff
options.rationale: Review is still necessary after implementation.

items.explanation: Correct: planning surfaces dependencies and ordering so changes stay coherent.

items.stem: Which TWO properties should each step of a decomposed feature have? (Select TWO.)

options.text: It leaves the codebase in a working, buildable state
options.rationale: Correct: working intermediate states keep the change recoverable.

options.text: It has a defined way to verify it succeeded
options.rationale: Correct: a per-step check catches errors early.

options.text: It touches as many files as possible at once
options.rationale: Maximising blast radius per step makes failures harder to isolate.

options.text: It is never reviewed until the whole feature is done
options.rationale: Deferring all review increases the cost of mistakes.

items.explanation: Correct: working intermediate states keep the change recoverable.
items.domain_ref: Decomposing a feature into ordered steps

items.stem: During implementation Claude Code also renames unrelated variables across the repo. In review, this is:

options.text: Scope creep that should be removed from this change
options.rationale: Correct: unrelated edits expand risk and should be split out.

options.text: A helpful bonus to merge as-is
options.rationale: Unrelated changes bundled in obscure review and raise risk.
Passing tests do not justify unreviewed scope expansion.

options.text: Required before the feature can work
options.rationale: The rename is unrelated to the feature's requirements.

items.explanation: Correct: unrelated edits expand risk and should be split out.
